video_title: SHUT UP! 🗣️ Stephen A. remembers being FURIOUS about the Knicks facing MJ 📣 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson credits his parents for his Mamba Mentality
quotes.excerpt: The way I carry myself and the way I do things is a credit to how I was raised.
quotes.quote: The way I carry myself and the way I do things is a credit to how I was raised by my parents. Part of their philosophy seeps into the Mamba mentality as well, so there's a connectivity there. I do my best to stay present in the moment, to do the things I can, to make sure my mind is right, being mentally and physically ready every day. Trusting my work is what's got me here.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilson argues Jalen Brunson's game is built on hard work
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson's game is made. He has a saying that the magic is in the work.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson's game is made. He has a saying that the magic is in the work. It is. His foundation is second round. He wears that chip on his shoulder every day. He's reminding himself and reminding everybody else. I know what you thought of me and he's playing so far beyond it. It's great.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilson compares the ruthlessness of Kobe Bryant to other legends
quotes.excerpt: Kobe had a ruthlessness that was shared by very few players in my observation.
quotes.quote: Kobe had a ruthlessness that was shared by very few players in my observation. Bird, Jordan, Kobe. I don't know that I put anybody else in that group. Even other great players, LeBron, I don't put LeBron in that group in terms of ruthlessness. And I don't put Jalen Brunson in it. Not yet. That takes a lot more winning.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay Williams recounts Jalen Brunson's gritty work ethic in Chicago
quotes.excerpt: I left practice with scratch claw marks all over my forearms. That dude was gritty.
quotes.quote: I played with Rick Brunson in Chicago. I left practice with scratch claw marks all over my forearms. That dude was gritty, he was grimy as hell, he was talking trash to you. And that's who Jalen was around growing up. Every time I saw Jalen, Jalen was asking questions to other great players that just happened to be around Rick.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith defines Mamba Mentality as having influence
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't make you the Black Mamba. It just means that the Black Mamba had influence upon you.
quotes.quote: It doesn't make you the Black Mamba. It just means that the Black Mamba had influence upon you, or the kind of influence that's similar to what you're experiencing now. You have your history with Rick Brunson. I have mine. I'm a college beat writer for Temple University, Rick Brunson's last two years playing under John Chaney. That's how far back Rick Brunson and I go.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith explains the true meaning of Mamba Mentality
quotes.excerpt: Mamba mentality means your willingness to go get it, to take no prisoners.
quotes.quote: When you talk about the Mamba mentality, let's understand what that means. That means your willingness to go get it, to take no prisoners. You're not backing down from anything. You're not listening to naysayers and their doubts about you. It's utilized as fuel.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith recalls Kobe Bryant's singular focus on winning
quotes.excerpt: Kobe Bryant doesn't recall that he tried to emulate Jordan. Walked like him, talked like him.
quotes.quote: Kobe Bryant doesn't recall that he tried to emulate Jordan. Walked like him, talked like him. Kobe Bryant looked at the turnaround jump shot, going to a meeting with Nike, and then sitting out while they're negotiating some deal, he out there shooting 500 shots from the baseline. The things that he did, his whole thing was, he didn't view it as the doubts that he created, because it was clear what he was shooting for and what he wanted to be.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith remembers being furious about the Knicks facing Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I'm like, shut up! Don't say anything. Don't do it. This is not the guy to do it.
quotes.quote: I'm like, shut up! Don't say anything. Don't do it. This is not the guy to do it. New York Daily News, the loop, we're going to shut up. Don't say anything, because Michael Jordan is like this. What? They acting like I'm doing something wrong to my team? He come out the next game, he beat them. And then Game 4 was when he dropped 54. And I'm like, damn!
